title: Unique normalized Cech edge for arbitrary module coefficients
statement: For a small site C with precoverage J satisfying the site axioms, a sheaf of rings R with enough injectives in its module category, a module M, and a finite covering U_i → X with a chosen SiteCechComplex S, every natural degree q has a unique map from H^q(S.complex M) to right-derived evaluation of M at X satisfying S.IsNormalizedEdge. Neither terminality of X nor acyclicity of M is required. Notation: sites and their evaluation functors are [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]; module categories are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; injective resolutions are [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. The chosen Cech complex is [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], its signed first-quadrant total is [def-sp-double-complex-total], and its augmentations and normalization are [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-edge-normalization].

proof.text: Define the edge by H(beta), inverse H(alpha), and the inverse injective-resolution comparison. A strict resolution comparison commutes with alpha by restriction naturality and beta by its augmentation identity. Apply homology and the canonical resolution-comparison naturality to prove the edge equation for every resolution.

proof.text: The prescribed degreewise formulas force any two augmentations to agree. Evaluate two normalized edges at one injective resolution and cancel its canonical comparison and invertible H(alpha), proving uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSite_normalized_cech_edge
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : Precoverage C) [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition]
    [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    (R : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck RingCat.{u})
    [EnoughInjectives (ringedSiteModules.{u} R)]
    (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} R)
    {X : C} {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (U : I → C) (v : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (hU : Presieve.ofArrows U v ∈ J X) (S : SiteCechComplex U v) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃! e : (S.cohomologyFunctor q).obj M.val.presheaf ⟶
      (((SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj) ⋙
        (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op X)).rightDerived q).obj M,
      S.IsNormalizedEdge (SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj) q e
